fusions.name: Chink Finder
fusions.desc: Strikes the target, dealing 5 piercing damage and leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Seam Splitter
fusions.desc: Drives a spike into the target, dealing 30 piercing damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, ignoring the target's armour.

fusions.name: Hardened Membrane
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Last Stand
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
